# Data quality rules

Rules run on every pipeline run and their results are stored in `analytics_meta.dq_results`.

* **quarantine**: failing rows are kept out of the warehouse and copied (pseudonymised) to `analytics_meta.quarantine`.
* **flag**: rows are loaded; the failure is recorded for review.
* **report**: a check on the result of the load (reconciliation and consistency).
* **block**: the run stops before loading (used for unexpected source schema changes).

## Before loading

| Rule | Dataset | Severity | Action | What it checks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `appointment_required_fields` | appointment | error | quarantine | Appointment has a doctor, a valid date, valid start and end times and a known status. |
| `appointment_unknown_status` | appointment | error | quarantine | Status is one of the hospital's codes (NotDone, Done). |
| `appointment_invalid_time_range` | appointment | error | quarantine | Appointment ends after it starts. |
| `appointment_duplicate_id` | appointment | error | quarantine | Each appointment id appears once in the extract. |
| `appointment_orphan_doctor` | appointment | error | quarantine | Appointment belongs to a doctor that exists. |
| `appointment_doctor_unknown_department` | appointment | error | quarantine | The appointment's doctor belongs to a known department. |
| `appointment_duplicate_slot` | appointment | error | quarantine | A doctor has at most one appointment starting at the same date and time (later ids are held back). |
| `appointment_implausible_date` | appointment | warning | flag | Appointment date is between 2000-01-01 and one year from today. |
| `appointment_without_patient` | appointment | warning | flag | Appointment is linked to a patient. (A patient can hide a completed visit, which removes the link.) |
| `appointment_multiple_patients` | appointment | warning | flag | Appointment is linked to at most one patient. |
| `patient_link_orphan` | appointment_patient | error | flag | Every appointment-patient link points to a patient that exists. |
| `completed_without_diagnosis` | appointment | warning | flag | Appointments marked done have a diagnosis recorded. |
| `diagnosis_on_open_appointment` | appointment | warning | flag | Appointments with a diagnosis are marked done. |
| `doctor_without_schedule` | doctor | warning | flag | Active doctors have working hours, so their capacity can be measured. |
| `schedule_break_outside_hours` | doctor_schedule | warning | flag | The break starts within working hours. |
| `doctor_negative_fee` | doctor | warning | flag | Consultation fees are not negative. |
| `data_freshness` | pipeline | warning | report | The previous successful run finished within PIPELINE_FRESHNESS_HOURS. |
| `unexpected_schema_change` | source_schema | error | block | Columns the pipeline reads still exist with the same type as when it first ran. |

## After loading

| Rule | Dataset | Severity | Action | What it checks |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `source_to_target_reconciliation` | fact_appointment | error | report | Every appointment in the source is in the warehouse or in quarantine, and the warehouse has no active appointment the source no longer has. |
| `dim_doctor_one_current_version` | dim_doctor | error | report | Each doctor in the source has exactly one current version in the doctor dimension. |
| `fact_status_consistent` | fact_appointment | error | report | Removed appointments have the removed status and active ones do not. |
